pages.text: Altered from $(5)Sharpness$(), $(4)Xenophobia$() greatly increases damage against enemies that aren't undead, arthropods or aquatic. Maximum level is $(4)V$() and it conflicts with $(5)Sharpness$(), $(5)Smite$(), $(5)Bane of Arthropods$(), $(5)Impaling$() and $(4)Hunter's Exultation$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: While Sharpness is better for general use, Xenophobia deals more damage, meaning that it has its use cases, just like any other specialized 'damage enchantment'.
